title: Create a branch
summary: A branch is each physical location where you see patients. Rooms and schedules hang from a branch.

steps.title: Branch name
steps.details: It's what the team chooses when working and the patient when booking online. Use a short, recognizable name.
steps.description: Use a name the team recognizes quickly: Downtown, Pocitos, Route 5 Office…

steps.title: Address
steps.details: If you enter it, it shows on the map, in reminders and on the portal; without an address the patient can't see where to go.
steps.description: It shows on the map, on the patient portal and in reminders.

steps.title: Phone
steps.details: This branch's phone. If you leave it empty the clinic's is used.

steps.title: Email
steps.details: This branch's email. If you leave it empty the clinic's is used.

steps.title: Create the branch
steps.details: Creates the branch as active. An inactive branch isn't offered for booking but keeps its history.
steps.description: Review the details and press Create.
